scope: Two D+D rate-shape parameters to local BBN observable sensitivities; no full nuclear covariance, posterior, likelihood, or scientific acceptance.

rate_model.q_distribution_marginals: N(0,1), unit marginal variance by parameterization
rate_model.temperature_semantics: One q_i per reaction is shared over the complete temperature table; f_i(T) is the pinned temperature-dependent expsigma column, not a scalar multiplier.
rate_model.interpolation: LINX native linear interpolation on unchanged Reaction.T9_vec nodes
rate_model.reverse_rates: Native detailed balance from the same perturbed forward table
rate_model.other_reactions: q=0 and native tables unchanged in every realization
rate_model.adapter_semantics: The adapter zeroes native q for the two replaced channels before precompute, then replaces only those two tables; no second application of q.

design.baseline: One native standard-background BBN integration with q=0 for every reaction; this is the centre of the local response.
design.perturbations: Eight adapter integrations: each D+D channel at q=+/-1 and +/-0.5, with the other D+D channel and every other reaction fixed at q=0.
design.finite_difference_scope: Central finite difference in the one-dimensional q_i direction; this estimates a local derivative, not the full nonlinear response over q~N(0,1).
execution_order: measure baseline wall time and publish forecast

observables.D_H: Y_d/Y_p; proton abundance is the hydrogen-number proxy used by this LINX output.
observables.He3_H_late: (Y_He3+Y_t)/Y_p; includes tritium that beta-decays to He3 after BBN.
observables.Li7_H_late: (Y_Li7+Y_Be7)/Y_p; includes Be7 that electron-captures to Li7 after BBN.

correlation_model.rho_status: UNMEASURED_PARAMETER; no joint experimental D+D posterior/covariance is present in the pinned audit. rho is not assigned a measured value or prior.
correlation_model.independent_comparator: rho=0 with the same N(0,1) marginals; comparator only, not a claim that physical errors are independent.

linearized_propagation.variance: Var(ln O) approximately a^T R_rho a = a1^2+a2^2+2*rho*a1*a2
linearized_propagation.bounds: -1<=kappa<=1 and -1<=rho<=1; kappa=1 iff a1=a2, kappa=-1 iff a1=-a2; ratio is real for every admissible pair.
linearized_propagation.limitation: Delta-method/local-Jacobian result only. It is not the exact covariance of nonlinear BBN outputs over a broad q distribution; nonlinear correlated MC and posterior for rho remain separate work.

preregistered_directional_hypotheses.D_H: a_ddHe3n<0 and a_ddtp<0 expected because both forward D+D channels consume deuterium; directional hypothesis, not a solver acceptance criterion.
preregistered_directional_hypotheses.He3_H_late: both derivatives expected positive from direct He3 production and T->He3 decay; network-mediated destruction can reverse the net sign, so this is diagnostic, not an acceptance gate.
preregistered_directional_hypotheses.Li7_H_late: both derivatives tentatively expected positive via T/He3 flow into Li7/Be7; competing reaction flows can reverse the net sign, so this is diagnostic, not an acceptance gate.
preregistered_directional_hypotheses.Yp: no sign prediction; report both derivatives and the absolute D+D variance contribution, not a relative kappa-only diagnostic.

step_convergence.comparison: a_i(h=1) versus a_i(h=0.5), independently for each observable and channel
step_convergence.near_zero_rule: If max(|a_1|,|a_0.5|)<1e-8, report NEAR_ZERO_RESPONSE and do not use a relative percentage; otherwise require |a_1-a_0.5|/max(|a_1|,|a_0.5|)<0.01 for STEP_CONVERGED.
step_convergence.failure_policy: Report STEP_NOT_CONVERGED; no silent h=0.25 rerun or automatic retry. Any smaller-step follow-up is a separately admitted package.
